name: Emblemform
description: A shield outline with a bar across its top third.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 12% 20%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 56.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 56.0%); clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 56.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 56.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 20%; right: 20%; top: 30%; height: 12%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
